contents.text: {"answer":"Recall 24V868000 matches the reported failure: the owner said the car would not accelerate and reported an ICCU failure, while the recall describes ICCU damage that can cause loss of drive power. The other listed recall, 24V204000, covers the same failure but was replaced by 24V868000. The newer recall also requires its remedy for vehicles previously repaired under the older recall.","scope":"answered","recheck":false,"citations":[{"kind":"complaint","id":"11714455","quote":"Car would not accelerate"},{"kind":"complaint","id":"11714455","quote":"they said it is an ICCU failure"},{"kind":"recall","id":"24V868000","quote":"The Integrated Charging Control Unit (ICCU) may become damaged and stop charging the 12-volt battery, which can result in a loss of drive power."},{"kind":"recall","id":"24V204000","quote":"This recall is replaced by NHTSA recall number 24V-868."},{"kind":"recall","id":"24V204000","quote":"which can result in a loss of drive power"},{"kind":"recall","id":"24V868000","quote":"Vehicles previously repaired under recall 24V-204 will need to have the new remedy completed."}]}
